# Bird's Eye Site Location Intelligence

> Zoning, entitlement, and location reports for developers, lenders, brokers, and site selectors. Scoped in one form, quoted in writing, prepared and verified by a senior land-use professional, delivered in two to eight business days. Focused on the Northeast and the Southern states; parcels taken anywhere in the US.

Bird's Eye is NESO HQ LLC's site research service at https://birdseye.nesohq.com/. It starts with a free instant read (a 30-second estimate of an entitlement timeline, by state and project type); each written report is scoped in one form and quoted in writing before any work starts.

## Reports

- [Location Data Audit](https://birdseye.nesohq.com/order-location-data-audit.html)
- [Power & Energization Screen](https://birdseye.nesohq.com/order-power-energization-screen.html)
- [Site Readiness & Feasibility Snapshot](https://birdseye.nesohq.com/order-site-readiness-feasibility.html)
- [Site Snapshot](https://birdseye.nesohq.com/order-site-snapshot.html)
- [Zoning & Entitlement Readiness](https://birdseye.nesohq.com/order-zoning-entitlement-readiness.html)

## Who it is for

Developers, landowners, lenders, brokers, site selectors, cities, counties and economic development groups.

## About NESO

Bird's Eye is made by NESO HQ LLC, which offers advisory services, research reports and free tools for founders,
small businesses, developers and municipalities: https://nesohq.com/ (its llms.txt: https://nesohq.com/llms.txt).
Questions: hello@nesohq.com · (901) 295-0322.
